rule: A root is NOT counted / selected when one of its non-target objects cannot be picked from where it stands even with every other object gone (under the scene's own arm ceiling: tallest object + 10 cm). Such an object could never be moved.

statuses.AUTHOR_QC_PASS: author's per-object evidence covers every non-target object and all pass; re-check here agrees
statuses.QC_DISAGREE_EXCLUDED: author and re-check disagree on some object (excluded, conservative)
statuses.QC_FAIL_FIXED_OBJECT: a non-target object cannot be picked (excluded)
statuses.SIDECAR_REPRO_QC_PASS: at least one non-target object had no author result; the author's unmodified tool, re-run here, passes every non-target object (kept separate from author-approved roots)
statuses.VACUOUS_PASS_NO_NON_TARGET: the root has no non-target object (provable from the root file)
